name: elasticore
description: Work on ElastiCORE projects through their YAML DSL: skills that know which files the generator owns, draft a reproducible ElastiCORE issue and plan work on ElastiCORE itself, and hooks that stop hand edits to generated code and have the agent generate and compile before it finishes.

interface.shortDescription: Keep an agent on the DSL side of an ElastiCORE project
